About Capture Heaven

Capture Heaven came from the desire and heart to serve, not only a ministry but the minister as well. I use the skills that God has gifted me to push forward the vision of those I work for.

My Heart

To serve ministries and help bring their visions to life.

My Mission

To advance the vision of the minister and the ministry with excellence in everything I do.

My Promise

Everything done with excellence. Vision-driven service that fills in the gaps.

My story

Not long after I got saved, I started serving as the drummer for the worship team at my home church. From there, I moved to attend Revival Today Bible Institute. While I’m there, I serve at Revival Today Church in the usher and media departments at just about every service I can.

What I love most about serving is being in the house and receiving an impartation while I serve. I get to honor God with the gifts He has given me.

God called me to the helps ministry: to be a second, and to serve an evangelistic ministry, a church, or both. Once I understood that call, I realized why God gave me these gifts. They are for helping a minister. That’s why I started Capture Heaven in 2026.

— William Kittle, Owner of Capture Heaven

Common questions

To book me for an event, tap Book and fill out the short form with your preferred dates and location. To bring me onto your team for contract, full-time, or part-time work, use the Hire Will form. I read every request myself and reply within 24 hours.

Media (photography, filming, photo and video editing, and graphics), usher and security, and worship drumming. Yes, you can request more than one. On the booking form, choose Other and list everything you need. On the hire form, select every role that applies.

Please reach out at least two weeks ahead. I’m based in Pittsburgh, PA, and I travel anywhere in the US and internationally. I work by honorarium and pay for my own travel and hotel, so I come at no cost to your church or ministry. I simply ask that the ministry give as it sees fit.

I deliver everything through Dropbox as soon as it’s edited. For media, I can bring my own gear or use yours. For drums, I play your church’s kit.
